strayclient.menu.title: Stray Client
strayclient.menu.cape.tip: Shows your PNG cape. Pick one in the launcher first (Capes tab).
strayclient.menu.mods.empty: No extra mods yet. Add some in the launcher (Mods tab).
strayclient.menu.mods.restart: Mod changes apply after restarting the game.
strayclient.menu.mods.locked: Part of the client, always on.
strayclient.menu.modules.more: Turn on Keystrokes and PvP Plus in the launcher (Modules tab).
strayclient.menu.hud.tip: Drag Keystrokes and the PvP HUD to any place on your screen.
strayclient.hud.title: Drag the modules to where you want them
strayclient.hud.empty: No movable module is on. Turn on Keystrokes or PvP Plus first.
strayclient.menu.host.tip: Share this world with friends anywhere: they join with the address shown in chat.
strayclient.host.on: Your world is now hosted. Send your friends the address from the chat line below (click it to copy). They join via Multiplayer → Direct Connection.
strayclient.host.lan: Your world is open to your local network (LAN). For hosting worldwide, start it with “Host” in Stray Client.
strayclient.title.mods.tip: Switch modules and mods on and off, move the HUD.
strayclient.title.classic.tip: Back to Minecraft's own main menu. Turn the Stray menu on again with Right Shift.
strayclient.menu.mainmenu.tip: Shows the Stray Client main menu instead of Minecraft's title screen.
